name: axiombuild
description: Bookkeeping for spec-driven coding projects. Owns the inbox of feature documents waiting to be built, records which one is open, and archives each with a changelog entry and a release tag when it lands. It does not plan, implement or verify - superpowers does that, with the repository readable. Pairs with AxiomCore, which writes the feature documents. Run /scope init in a new project folder to begin.
